[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Car Pooling** [LC 1094 · Car Pooling](https://leetcode.com/problems/car-pooling/){difficulty="Medium"}

This is @sec-int-p2-a's max-overlap query with a threshold and a different convention. Each trip is an interval $[\text{from}, \text{to})$ — *half-open*, because riders alight *at* `to` and the seats are free from that marker onward. The vehicle can serve every trip iff the maximum number of simultaneously-riding passengers never exceeds `capacity`. Because the coordinates are bounded by $1000$, no compression is needed and the whole timeline fits in a fixed-size `diff[1001]` array — this is the same *difference-array* trick as @sec-pref, just reinterpreted as "add $+p$ at `from`, subtract $-p$ at `to`."

[Solved in full in @sec-int-p2-b.]{.card-link}
